name: grocer
description: Grocer - a local grocery delivery web app connecting buyers with neighbourhood grocery sellers.

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend

author: Grocer Team
